timeline.summary: Krenko urges his goblins to bring death to enemies.
timeline.quote: We'll bring death, shiny sharp, to our enemies.

citation.text: Fervor (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mr. Taz meets Krenko in a smoky pub and hires him for a Boros heist, giving him a glowing shiv.
timeline.quote: Here is a special tool to help you in your endeavor."

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
timeline.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A fistfight breaks out among the soldiers, and Krenko enjoys the tension.
timeline.quote: Such undisciplined hot-headedness seemed very un-Boros.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
timeline.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko sets fires and bombs through the floors of Sunhome to create chaos and slips unnoticed into Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: Chaos is the best cover, and Krenko went about setting fires and kicking down doors.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko finds an angel in stasis inside a detention sphere and smashes it open with the shiv's handle.
timeline.quote: With another good smash, the sphere dissipated, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko plucks two feathers from the angel and falsely screams that she attacked him, and guards seize her.
timeline.quote: "She tried to escape! She's free. She attacked me!"

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: As Krenko leaves, a large explosion rocks Sunhome.
timeline.quote: a large explosion rocked Sunhome.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Krenko delivers the angel's feather to Taz on the Millennial and receives an Orzhov safebox key holding Feather's money.
timeline.quote: Taz handed him a silver key with the Orzhov symbol carved into the shaft.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Taz hints at a further job in the Orzhova after calling Krenko the boss of something grand.
timeline.quote: I can see you as the boss of something grand.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
timeline.quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
timeline.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
timeline.quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Krenko accepts a job from Mr. Taz to raid the Boros guildhall and is given a glowing shiv.
timeline.quote: Mr. Taz gave Krenko a tool specially made for that job.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveils Sunhome, pushes it into violence and uses the chaos to reach Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: He provided that push and used the ensuing chaos to cover his actions

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko breaks the detention sphere holding an angel, plucks two feathers and falsely blames her escape before fleeing.
timeline.quote: He broke the sphere, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mr. Taz offers Krenko another job at an Orzhov bank, and an Izzet portal opens nearby.
timeline.quote: an Izzet experiment unintentionally opened a portal nearby

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a goblin gang war Krenko kills Dargig and is arrested by Gideon Jura, injuring him with the shiv.
timeline.quote: Krenko killed Dargig, the youngest of the Shattergang Brothers

citation.text: "Krenko", section "In and out of prison". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko incites a riot at Sawtooth Prison, is transferred toward Udzec, and escapes to rejoin his gang.
timeline.quote: he was able to slip away to rendezvous with his gang

citation.text: "Krenko", section "In and out of prison". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Bolas's invasion, Krenko and the goblins steal treasures from evacuated locations.
timeline.quote: Krenko and the other goblins stole treasures

citation.text: "Krenko", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko fights in defense of Ravnica during the Phyrexian invasion while profiting from looting behind Phyrexian lines.
timeline.quote: Krenko fought in defense of Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With his enterprise rebuilt, Krenko sets his sights on joining Ravnica's monied elites and elevating his goblin gang.
timeline.quote: he has set his sights on his next goal: joining the ranks of Ravnica's monied elites

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa presses Krenko about the debt he owes the Karlovs.
timeline.quote: Think, Krenko. You owe the Karlovs.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: The goblin kidnappers carry Kylox to a pawnshop.
timeline.quote: the goblins carried Kylox to a disreputable-looking pawnshop.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Krenko interrogates Kylox about the killings out of fear for himself.
timeline.quote: I know enough to know I'm at risk here. You're going to tell me everything you know.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Etrata subdues Krenko's six guards.
timeline.quote: in moments, all six guards were on the ground, not moving.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: A drugged attacker crashes in, kills Kylox, and is subdued by Etrata.
timeline.quote: There was a strangled gasp as the viashino fell out of the way and slid, motionless, to the floor.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ral, Vannifar and Krenko arrive; Kaya shows Krenko to Trostani's sanctum.
timeline.quote: Vannifar was the last of the guild leaders to arrive, shortly after Ral

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba accuses Krenko of hoarding and price-gouging during the invasion.
timeline.quote: was hoarding resources

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Krenko admits goblins died to get the supplies and he profited.
timeline.quote: Goblins died getting those supplies from behind enemy lines.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba says she sent an assassin after Krenko and Kylox was in the way.
timeline.quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.
timeline.quote: all save Krenko, who found himself dragged along by a furious Aurelia determined to see someone arrested

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kylox is abducted by goblins and stabbed at Krenko's safehouse.
timeline.quote: a citizen burst into the window, bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba captures Aurelia, freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her; Aurelia arrests Krenko.
timeline.quote: Aurelia was captured, but was freed after Kaya and Etrata defeated Oba

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Crime wave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Goblins abduct Kylox from his laboratory; Etrata and Proft track them to Krenko's safehouse, where Etrata dispatches his minions and an enchanted citizen fatally stabs Kylox.
timeline.quote: a citizen burst into the window bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko sneaks into Teysa Karlov's party to network and is noticed by the host, to whom he owes a debt.
timeline.quote: Krenko acquired an invitation and snuck in to attempt networking

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fearing he is next after the murders of Zegana and Teysa, Krenko kidnaps Kylox but is thwarted by Proft and Etrata; a brainwashed citizen attacks and accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: accidentally killing Kylox first

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals that Oba organized the murders; Krenko is captured when Oba attacks but freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat her, then arrested by Aurelia.
timeline.quote: He was later arrested by Aurelia

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko is held at Sawtooth Prison after murdering Dargig, until he stages a riot to be transferred to Udzec in Precinct Two.
timeline.quote: where Krenko was held prisoner after his murder of Dargig of the Shattergang Brothers

citation.text: "Precinct Four", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko staged a riot at Sawtooth Prison, then staged an escape while being transferred to Udzec.
timeline.quote: Krenko was being transferred here from Sawtooth Prison in Precinct Four after he staged a riot, but staged an escape during the transfer.

citation.text: "Precinct Two", section "Neighborhoods and Landmarks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders as retribution against those she considered traitors.
timeline.quote: Proft revealed that Trostani — specifically Oba — was responsible for organizing the murders

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dars later rescues Gideon and trapped hostages during a goblin gang war.
timeline.quote: coming to the rescue of Gideon Jura and some trapped hostages

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko frees Feather in a secretive raid.
timeline.quote: Feather was freed, however, during a secretive raid performed by Krenko .

citation.text: "Feather", section "Deposed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kylox is enlisted by Ezrim for a secret project and moves it to a secret tunnel after his lab is ransacked by Krenko's underlings.
timeline.quote: Kylox was enlisted by the archon Ezrim for a project he was to keep secret

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko's minions kidnap Kylox; Proft and Etrata free him but a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: he was accidentally killed by a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl tries to kill Proft but Etrata stops her; Krenko kidnaps Kylox, who is accidentally killed.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl attempted to assassinate Proft but was stopped by Etrata

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft gathers the guild leaders and reveals Oba as the killer; Oba confesses her motives.
timeline.quote: revealed the killer as Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
